Wind & weather data [W]

Open-Meteo Forecast API · Best Match. Wind is at 10 m; gust values are preceding-hour maxima. Knots are calculated from the requested km/h using kn = km/h ÷ 1.852. Visibility is converted from metres to kilometres. UV, precipitation and sunrise/sunset come from this same response. [W]

Water temperature model [S]

Météo-France ocean model via Open-Meteo, explicitly selected with models=meteofrance_currents. This is modelled sea-surface temperature on an approximately 8 km grid, not a local coastal sensor. No independent local observation is integrated; the displayed number must not be presented as a verified beach measurement.
